parts.text: Edit this image: make the masked ball in his left hand much SMALLER, the size of a baseball, sitting snugly in his palm with his fingers curled around it. Keep the ball design exactly the same: glossy purple top, white bottom, the mask with its top half purple and bottom half beige, the purple button with white ring on the nose, the seam. Keep the man, his face, cap, pin vest, gold axe, pose and background exactly the same.
